items.title: Etta Jones interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Tim, can we go on this cruise?

ctx.x: Thank you so much. Are you going to be on this cruise?
I don’t think so. Tim, can we go on this cruise? That was a slice of heaven. I mean I have to tell you that I agreed with you, it was like being in another world. © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-
